27	class MetaCatalog:
28	    def __init__(self) -> None:
29	        self._registry = Registry()
30	        self._index = SearchIndex()
31	        self._reports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
32	        self._indexed_reports: set[str] = set()
33	
34	    # ============================================================ 注册：Schema
35	    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
36	        """注册一个不可变的 Schema 版本。文档不合法时抛 SchemaComparisonInvalid。"""
37	        validate_schema(document)
38	        record = self._registry.register_schema(name, version, document)
39	        self._index_schema(record.name, record.version, record.document, record.title)
40	        return self.get_schema(name, version)
41	
42	    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
43	        record = self._registry.get_schema(name, version)
44	        return {
45	            "name": record.name,
46	            "version": record.version,
47	            "title": record.title,
48	            "document": copy.deepcopy(record.document),
49	        }
50	
51	    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
52	        return self._registry.list_versions(name)
53	
54	    # ============================================================== 注册：资产
55	    def register_asset(
56	        self,
57	        asset_id: str,
58	        name: str,
59	        kind: str,
60	        refs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
61	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
62	        """注册目录资产。
63	
64	        ``refs`` 为 ``[{"schema": 名, "version": 版本, "path": 字段指针}, ...]``，
65	        表示资产对字段的直接引用；路径可写文档指针（``/properties/a``）或
66	        逻辑字段路径（``/a``），注册时统一规整。
67	        """
68	        asset = self._registry.register_asset(asset_id, name, kind, refs or [])
69	        self._index_asset(asset.id, asset.name, asset.kind, list(asset.refs))
70	        return self._asset_view(asset)
71	
72	    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
73	        return self._asset_view(self._registry.get_asset(asset_id))
74	
75	    @staticmethod
76	    def _asset_view(asset) -> dict[str, Any]:
77	        return {
78	            "asset_id": asset.id,
79	            "name": asset.name,
80	            "kind": asset.kind,
81	            "refs": [
82	                {"schema": r.schema, "version": r.version, "path": r.path}
83	                for r in asset.refs
84	            ],
85	        }
86	
87	    # ================================================================ 影响分析
88	    def analyze_impact(self, name: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
89	        """字段级影响分析：返回直接引用资产与经其他 Schema 传递引用的资产。"""
90	        return analyze_field(self._registry, name, version, path)
91	
92	    # ============================================================ 影响链路解释
93	    def explain_impact(
94	        self,
95	        name: str,
96	        version: str,
97	        path: str,
98	        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
99	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
100	        """按资产解释指定 Schema 版本中逻辑字段的影响链路（只读）。
101	
102	        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
103	        空列表不选任何资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。所查 Schema、
104	        版本不存在或字段不可达时同样抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
105	
106	        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``path`` 与按 ``asset_id`` 升序的
107	        ``assets``；每个资产含 ``impact_kind``（``direct`` / ``transitive``
108	        / ``both``）与 ``chains``。直接命中是零步链（``source == target ==
109	        所查字段``）；传递命中给出沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 的实际步进链，同一
110	        ``(source, target)`` 只保留一条最短链（等长取步进定位元组稳定最小
111	        者）。超过既有链深度、引用边或资产上限时抛
112	        :class:`ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
113	
114	        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
115	        返回值为独立副本，相同输入得到相同结果。
116	        """
117	        return explain_field(self._registry, name, version, path, asset_ids)
118	
119	    # ============================================================ 引用完整性审计
120	    def check_schema_references(
121	        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
122	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
123	        """审计已注册 Schema 版本中的跨 Schema ``$ref`` 完整性（只读）。
124	
125	        无参数审计全部版本；只给 ``name`` 按注册顺序审计该名称的各版本；
126	        只给 ``version`` 审计同版本号的全部 Schema；同时给出时审计指定版本，
127	        无匹配版本抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围。
128	
129	        返回普通 dict（可直接 JSON 序列化），含 ``checked``、``total``、
130	        ``resolved``、``issues``、``references``；审计不改动注册内容、
131	        不写入检索索引，相同输入返回相同结果。
132	        """
133	        return copy.deepcopy(audit_mod.check_references(self._registry, name, version))
134	
135	    # ======================================================== 字段级变更识别
136	    def compare_schemas(
137	        self,
138	        name: str,
139	        baseline_version: str,
140	        candidate: Any = None,
141	        *,
142	        candidate_version: str | None = None,
143	        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
144	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
145	        """比较基线版本与候选文档，生成并入库可检索的字段级变更报告。
146	
147	        ``candidate`` 直接给出候选 JSON Schema 文档；或省略它、仅传
148	        ``candidate_version`` 以引用同 Schema 标识下已注册的候选版本。
149	        ``renames`` 为 ``[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]``。
150	
151	        任何不合法情形统一抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
152	        相同输入返回相同报告（幂等，不会重复入库）。
153	        """
154	        # 1) 解析候选文档与基线版本。
155	        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
156	            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
157	        )
158	
159	        # 2) 生成报告（重命名校验在其中完成）。
160	        report = compare_mod.build_report(
161	            self._registry,
162	            name,
163	            baseline_version,
164	            candidate_document,
165	            label,
166	            renames,
167	        )
168	
169	        # 3) 幂等入库并进入全文检索范围。
170	        report_id = report["report_id"]
171	        if report_id not in self._reports:
172	            self._reports[report_id] = report
173	        if report_id not in self._indexed_reports:
174	            for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
175	                self._index_change(report, change, i)
176	            self._indexed_reports.add(report_id)
177	        return copy.deepcopy(report)
178	
179	    def _resolve_comparison_inputs(
180	        self,
181	        name: str,
182	        baseline_version: str,
183	        candidate: Any,
184	        candidate_version: str | None,
185	    ) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
186	        """解析并校验比较输入：候选文档（深拷贝）与候选版本标签、基线版本存在性。
187	
188	        校验口径与 :meth:`compare_schemas` 完全一致，失败时抛
189	        :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
190	        """
191	        if candidate is None:
192	            if candidate_version is None:
193	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
194	                    "必须提供候选文档 candidate 或已注册的 candidate_version",
195	                    details={"reason": "candidate_missing"},
196	                )
197	            try:
198	                candidate_record = self._registry.get_schema(name, candidate_version)
199	            except NotFoundError as exc:
200	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
201	                    f"指定版本 {name}@{candidate_version} 不存在",
202	                    details={"reason": "version_not_found", **exc.details},
203	                ) from exc
204	            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate_record.document)
205	            label = candidate_version
206	        else:
207	            validate_schema(candidate)
208	            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
209	            label = candidate_version  # 允许调用方给候选文档附带版本标签
210	
211	        if not self._registry.has_schema(name, baseline_version):
212	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
213	                f"指定版本 {name}@{baseline_version} 不存在",
214	                details={"reason": "version_not_found", "schema": name, "version": baseline_version},
215	            )
216	        return candidate_document, label
217	
218	    # ============================================================ 升级影响汇总
219	    def analyze_upgrade_impact(
220	        self,
221	        name: str,
222	        baseline_version: str,
223	        candidate: Any = None,
224	        *,
225	        candidate_version: str | None = None,
226	        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
227	        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
228	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
229	        """汇总一次升级对目录资产的影响（按资产维度的字段级变更视图）。
230	
231	        候选文档、候选版本、重命名映射与字段路径语义与
232	        :meth:`compare_schemas` 一致；``report_id`` 与相同输入的
233	        ``compare_schemas`` 相同。
234	
235	        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
236	        只覆盖所列资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
237	
238	        本调用为只读操作：不注册候选文档、不生成/改动变更报告、不写入检索
239	        索引；既有的读取、比较、影响分析与检索行为保持不变。
240	        """
241	        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
242	            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
243	        )
244	        summary = upgrade_mod.build_upgrade_report(
245	            self._registry,
246	            name,
247	            baseline_version,
248	            candidate_document,
249	            label,
250	            renames,
251	            asset_ids,
252	        )
253	        return copy.deepcopy(summary)
254	
255	    # ============================================================== 变更预检
256	    def preview_changes(
257	        self, changes: Any, *, search: dict[str, Any] | None = None
258	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
259	        """只读预检一批 Schema 变更：不注册、不生成报告、不写索引。
260	
261	        ``changes`` 为 JSON 列表，每项含 ``schema``、``version``、
262	        ``changeType`` 及对应内容；``changeType`` 仅限 ``add_field``、
263	        ``remove_field``、``change_type``、``compatibility_check``、
264	        ``unregister_schema``。``search`` 沿用 :meth:`search` 的检索条件，
265	        用于限定 ``searchPreview`` 的覆盖范围。
266	
267	        返回 ``accepted``、``conflicts``、``impactedItems``、
268	        ``searchPreview``；详见 :mod:`meta_catalog.preview`。
269	        """
270	        return preview_mod.preview_changes(self._registry, self._index, changes, search)
271	
272	    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
273	        if report_id not in self._reports:
274	            raise NotFoundError(
275	                f"变更报告 {report_id} 不存在", details={"report_id": report_id}
276	            )
277	        return copy.deepcopy(self._reports[report_id])
278	
279	    def list_reports(
280	        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
281	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
282	        """列出报告摘要（可按 Schema 名称与版本过滤，版本匹配基线或候选）。"""
283	        out = []
284	        for rid in sorted(self._reports):
285	            r = self._reports[rid]
286	            if name is not None and r["schema"] != name:
287	                continue
288	            if version is not None and version not in (
289	                r["baseline_version"],
290	                r["candidate_version"],
291	            ):
292	                continue
293	            out.append(
294	                {
295	                    "report_id": r["report_id"],
296	                    "schema": r["schema"],
297	                    "baseline_version": r["baseline_version"],
298	                    "candidate_version": r["candidate_version"],
299	                    "summary": r["summary"],
300	                }
301	            )
302	        return out
303	
304	    # ================================================================== 检索
305	    def search(self, keyword: str | None = None, **filters: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
306	        """组合检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更。
307	
308	        可选过滤：``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、``change_kind``、
309	        ``compatibility``、``asset_name``、``doc_type``、``limit``。
310	        返回命中条目（含命中字段与命中资产摘要），排序稳定，与插入顺序无关。
311	        """
312	        return self._index.search(keyword, **filters)
313	
314	    def search_page(self, keyword: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
315	        """分页检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更（只读，不写索引）。
316	
317	        检索条件与排序口径和 :meth:`search` 完全一致：``keyword`` 与
318	        ``doc_type``、``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、
319	        ``change_kind``、``compatibility``、``asset_name``；另接受
320	        ``page_size``（默认 50，仅 1 到 200 的普通整数）与可选 ``cursor``。
321	        第一页不传 ``cursor``，后续页只传上一页返回的 ``next_cursor``。
322	
323	        返回 ``items``（与 ``search`` 同条件结果逐项同构且顺序一致）、
324	        ``total``（调用时索引命中总数）、``page_size``、``next_cursor``
325	        （不透明，末页为 None）。游标绑定全部查询条件与 ``page_size``，
326	        任何一项变化都不得复用。参数或游标不合法时抛
327	        :class:`meta_catalog.errors.SearchQueryInvalid`。
328	        """
329	        return self._index.search_page(keyword, **kwargs)
330	
331	    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 索引维护
332	    def _index_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any, title: str | None) -> None:
333	        fields = sf.expand(document)
334	        root = fields.get("")
335	        description = ""
336	        if root is not None:
337	            d = root.schema.get("description")
338	            description = d if isinstance(d, str) else ""
339	        text_fields = {
340	            "name": name,
341	            "version": version,
342	            "title": title or "",
343	            "description": description,
344	            "field_paths": "\n".join(sorted(fields)),
345	        }
346	        payload = {
347	            "name": name,
348	            "version": version,
349	            "title": title,
350	            "summary": {
351	                "name": name,
352	                "version": version,
353	                "title": title,
354	                "field_count": len(fields),
355	            },
356	        }
357	        self._index.add_doc(
358	            "schema", ("schema", name, version), text_fields, payload
359	        )
360	
361	    def _index_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, kind: str, refs: list[FieldRef]) -> None:
362	        schemas = sorted({r.schema for r in refs})
363	        versions = sorted({f"{r.schema}@{r.version}" for r in refs})
364	        text_fields = {
365	            "id": asset_id,
366	            "name": name,
367	            "kind": kind,
368	            "refs": "\n".join(f"{r.schema}@{r.version}{r.path}" for r in refs),
369	        }
370	        payload = {
371	            "id": asset_id,
372	            "name": name,
373	            "kind": kind,
374	            "schemas": schemas,
375	            "versions": versions,
376	            "summary": {
377	                "asset_id": asset_id,
378	                "name": name,
379	                "kind": kind,
380	                "ref_count": len(refs),
381	            },
382	        }
383	        self._index.add_doc("asset", ("asset", asset_id), text_fields, payload)
384	
385	    def _index_change(self, report: dict[str, Any], change: dict[str, Any], seq: int) -> None:
386	        key, text_fields, payload = indexing.change_doc(report, change, seq)
387	        self._index.add_doc("change", key, text_fields, payload)

"""公开门面：:class:`MetaCatalog`。

组合注册簿、Schema 校验、字段级比较、影响分析与全文检索。所有成功结果都以
普通 dict/list 返回（可直接 JSON 序列化）；注册、比较、读取与检索均不会改动
既有 Schema 的注册内容、版本关系与资产依赖关系。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from typing import Any

from . import audit as audit_mod
from . import compare as compare_mod
from . import indexing
from . import preview as preview_mod
from . import schema_fields as sf
from . import upgrade as upgrade_mod
from .errors import NotFoundError, SchemaComparisonInvalid
from .explain import explain_field
from .impact import analyze_field
from .registry import FieldRef, Registry
from .search import SearchIndex
from .validator import validate_schema


class MetaCatalog:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._registry = Registry()
        self._index = SearchIndex()
        self._reports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._indexed_reports: set[str] = set()

    # ============================================================ 注册：Schema
    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册一个不可变的 Schema 版本。文档不合法时抛 SchemaComparisonInvalid。"""
        validate_schema(document)
        record = self._registry.register_schema(name, version, document)
        self._index_schema(record.name, record.version, record.document, record.title)
        return self.get_schema(name, version)

    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = self._registry.get_schema(name, version)
        return {
            "name": record.name,
            "version": record.version,
            "title": record.title,
            "document": copy.deepcopy(record.document),
        }

    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
        return self._registry.list_versions(name)

    # ============================================================== 注册：资产
    def register_asset(
        self,
        asset_id: str,
        name: str,
        kind: str,
        refs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册目录资产。

        ``refs`` 为 ``[{"schema": 名, "version": 版本, "path": 字段指针}, ...]``，
        表示资产对字段的直接引用；路径可写文档指针（``/properties/a``）或
        逻辑字段路径（``/a``），注册时统一规整。
        """
        asset = self._registry.register_asset(asset_id, name, kind, refs or [])
        self._index_asset(asset.id, asset.name, asset.kind, list(asset.refs))
        return self._asset_view(asset)

    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._asset_view(self._registry.get_asset(asset_id))

    @staticmethod
    def _asset_view(asset) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "asset_id": asset.id,
            "name": asset.name,
            "kind": asset.kind,
            "refs": [
                {"schema": r.schema, "version": r.version, "path": r.path}
                for r in asset.refs
            ],
        }

    # ================================================================ 影响分析
    def analyze_impact(self, name: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """字段级影响分析：返回直接引用资产与经其他 Schema 传递引用的资产。"""
        return analyze_field(self._registry, name, version, path)

    # ============================================================ 影响链路解释
    def explain_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        version: str,
        path: str,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """按资产解释指定 Schema 版本中逻辑字段的影响链路（只读）。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        空列表不选任何资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。所查 Schema、
        版本不存在或字段不可达时同样抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``path`` 与按 ``asset_id`` 升序的
        ``assets``；每个资产含 ``impact_kind``（``direct`` / ``transitive``
        / ``both``）与 ``chains``。直接命中是零步链（``source == target ==
        所查字段``）；传递命中给出沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 的实际步进链，同一
        ``(source, target)`` 只保留一条最短链（等长取步进定位元组稳定最小
        者）。超过既有链深度、引用边或资产上限时抛
        :class:`ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。

        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
        返回值为独立副本，相同输入得到相同结果。
        """
        return explain_field(self._registry, name, version, path, asset_ids)

    # ============================================================ 引用完整性审计
    def check_schema_references(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """审计已注册 Schema 版本中的跨 Schema ``$ref`` 完整性（只读）。

        无参数审计全部版本；只给 ``name`` 按注册顺序审计该名称的各版本；
        只给 ``version`` 审计同版本号的全部 Schema；同时给出时审计指定版本，
        无匹配版本抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围。

        返回普通 dict（可直接 JSON 序列化），含 ``checked``、``total``、
        ``resolved``、``issues``、``references``；审计不改动注册内容、
        不写入检索索引，相同输入返回相同结果。
        """
        return copy.deepcopy(audit_mod.check_references(self._registry, name, version))

    # ======================================================== 字段级变更识别
    def compare_schemas(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """比较基线版本与候选文档，生成并入库可检索的字段级变更报告。

        ``candidate`` 直接给出候选 JSON Schema 文档；或省略它、仅传
        ``candidate_version`` 以引用同 Schema 标识下已注册的候选版本。
        ``renames`` 为 ``[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]``。

        任何不合法情形统一抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        相同输入返回相同报告（幂等，不会重复入库）。
        """
        # 1) 解析候选文档与基线版本。
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )

        # 2) 生成报告（重命名校验在其中完成）。
        report = compare_mod.build_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
        )

        # 3) 幂等入库并进入全文检索范围。
        report_id = report["report_id"]
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            self._reports[report_id] = report
        if report_id not in self._indexed_reports:
            for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
                self._index_change(report, change, i)
            self._indexed_reports.add(report_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(report)

    def _resolve_comparison_inputs(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any,
        candidate_version: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
        """解析并校验比较输入：候选文档（深拷贝）与候选版本标签、基线版本存在性。

        校验口径与 :meth:`compare_schemas` 完全一致，失败时抛
        :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        """
        if candidate is None:
            if candidate_version is None:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    "必须提供候选文档 candidate 或已注册的 candidate_version",
                    details={"reason": "candidate_missing"},
                )
            try:
                candidate_record = self._registry.get_schema(name, candidate_version)
            except NotFoundError as exc:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    f"指定版本 {name}@{candidate_version} 不存在",
                    details={"reason": "version_not_found", **exc.details},
                ) from exc
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate_record.document)
            label = candidate_version
        else:
            validate_schema(candidate)
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
            label = candidate_version  # 允许调用方给候选文档附带版本标签

        if not self._registry.has_schema(name, baseline_version):
            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                f"指定版本 {name}@{baseline_version} 不存在",
                details={"reason": "version_not_found", "schema": name, "version": baseline_version},
            )
        return candidate_document, label

    # ============================================================ 升级影响汇总
    def analyze_upgrade_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """汇总一次升级对目录资产的影响（按资产维度的字段级变更视图）。

        候选文档、候选版本、重命名映射与字段路径语义与
        :meth:`compare_schemas` 一致；``report_id`` 与相同输入的
        ``compare_schemas`` 相同。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        只覆盖所列资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        本调用为只读操作：不注册候选文档、不生成/改动变更报告、不写入检索
        索引；既有的读取、比较、影响分析与检索行为保持不变。
        """
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )
        summary = upgrade_mod.build_upgrade_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
            asset_ids,
        )
        return copy.deepcopy(summary)

    # ============================================================== 变更预检
    def preview_changes(
        self, changes: Any, *, search: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """只读预检一批 Schema 变更：不注册、不生成报告、不写索引。

        ``changes`` 为 JSON 列表，每项含 ``schema``、``version``、
        ``changeType`` 及对应内容；``changeType`` 仅限 ``add_field``、
        ``remove_field``、``change_type``、``compatibility_check``、
        ``unregister_schema``。``search`` 沿用 :meth:`search` 的检索条件，
        用于限定 ``searchPreview`` 的覆盖范围。

        返回 ``accepted``、``conflicts``、``impactedItems``、
        ``searchPreview``；详见 :mod:`meta_catalog.preview`。
        """
        return preview_mod.preview_changes(self._registry, self._index, changes, search)

    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"变更报告 {report_id} 不存在", details={"report_id": report_id}
            )
        return copy.deepcopy(self._reports[report_id])

    def list_reports(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """列出报告摘要（可按 Schema 名称与版本过滤，版本匹配基线或候选）。"""
        out = []
        for rid in sorted(self._reports):
            r = self._reports[rid]
            if name is not None and r["schema"] != name:
                continue
            if version is not None and version not in (
                r["baseline_version"],
                r["candidate_version"],
            ):
                continue
            out.append(
                {
                    "report_id": r["report_id"],
                    "schema": r["schema"],
                    "baseline_version": r["baseline_version"],
                    "candidate_version": r["candidate_version"],
                    "summary": r["summary"],
                }
            )
        return out

    # ================================================================== 检索
    def search(self, keyword: str | None = None, **filters: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """组合检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更。

        可选过滤：``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、``change_kind``、
        ``compatibility``、``asset_name``、``doc_type``、``limit``。
        返回命中条目（含命中字段与命中资产摘要），排序稳定，与插入顺序无关。
        """
        return self._index.search(keyword, **filters)

    def search_page(self, keyword: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """分页检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更（只读，不写索引）。

        检索条件与排序口径和 :meth:`search` 完全一致：``keyword`` 与
        ``doc_type``、``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、
        ``change_kind``、``compatibility``、``asset_name``；另接受
        ``page_size``（默认 50，仅 1 到 200 的普通整数）与可选 ``cursor``。
        第一页不传 ``cursor``，后续页只传上一页返回的 ``next_cursor``。

        返回 ``items``（与 ``search`` 同条件结果逐项同构且顺序一致）、
        ``total``（调用时索引命中总数）、``page_size``、``next_cursor``
        （不透明，末页为 None）。游标绑定全部查询条件与 ``page_size``，
        任何一项变化都不得复用。参数或游标不合法时抛
        :class:`meta_catalog.errors.SearchQueryInvalid`。
        """
        return self._index.search_page(keyword, **kwargs)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 索引维护
    def _index_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any, title: str | None) -> None:
        fields = sf.expand(document)
        root = fields.get("")
        description = ""
        if root is not None:
            d = root.schema.get("description")
            description = d if isinstance(d, str) else ""
        text_fields = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title or "",
            "description": description,
            "field_paths": "\n".join(sorted(fields)),
        }
        payload = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title,
            "summary": {
                "name": name,
                "version": version,
                "title": title,
                "field_count": len(fields),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc(
            "schema", ("schema", name, version), text_fields, payload
        )

    def _index_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, kind: str, refs: list[FieldRef]) -> None:
        schemas = sorted({r.schema for r in refs})
        versions = sorted({f"{r.schema}@{r.version}" for r in refs})
        text_fields = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "refs": "\n".join(f"{r.schema}@{r.version}{r.path}" for r in refs),
        }
        payload = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "schemas": schemas,
            "versions": versions,
            "summary": {
                "asset_id": asset_id,
                "name": name,
                "kind": kind,
                "ref_count": len(refs),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc("asset", ("asset", asset_id), text_fields, payload)

    def _index_change(self, report: dict[str, Any], change: dict[str, Any], seq: int) -> None:
        key, text_fields, payload = indexing.change_doc(report, change, seq)
        self._index.add_doc("change", key, text_fields, payload)

1	"""字段影响链路解释。
2	
3	在字段级影响分析（:mod:`meta_catalog.impact`）的命中口径之上，解释每个资产
4	*为什么* 受所查字段影响：
5	
6	  * 直接命中：资产引用的字段与所查字段精确相等，给出零步链，
7	    ``source == target == 所查字段``；
8	  * 传递命中：从资产引用的具体字段出发，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边正向解析，
9	    到达所查版本中与所查字段相等或祖先/后代包含的命中路径，给出实际步进链。
10	
11	同一 ``(source, target)`` 只保留一条最短链；等长时按步进定位元组
12	（逐步 ``from``/``to`` 的 ``(schema, version, path)``）取稳定最小者。
13	同一资产的直接与传递来源分别保留，``impact_kind`` 按实际命中合并为
14	``direct`` / ``transitive`` / ``both``。
15	
16	正向解析路径长度随跨边跳数只减不增，引用环不会产生重复链或无界结果。
17	本模块只读注册簿：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引。
18	"""
19	
20	from __future__ import annotations
21	
22	from typing import Any
23	
24	from . import limits, pointer as ptr
25	from .errors import ImpactAnalysisTooLarge, NotFoundError
26	from .impact import _build_outgoing, _related
27	from .registry import Registry
28	
29	# 状态定位：(schema, version, path) 三元组。
30	_State = tuple[str, str, str]
31	
32	
33	def _locator(state: _State) -> dict[str, Any]:
34	    return {"schema": state[0], "version": state[1], "path": state[2]}
35	
36	
37	def _resolve_asset_ids(
38	    registry: Registry, asset_ids: list[str] | None
39	) -> list[str]:
40	    """校验并去重资产选择，返回按 asset_id 升序的入选清单。
41	
42	    ``None`` 覆盖全部资产；空列表不选任何资产；未知资产抛
43	    :class:`NotFoundError`。
44	    """
45	    if asset_ids is None:
46	        return [a.id for a in registry.all_assets()]
47	    known = {a.id for a in registry.all_assets()}
48	    unique: set[str] = set()
49	    for aid in asset_ids:
50	        if not isinstance(aid, str) or not aid or aid not in known:
51	            raise NotFoundError(f"资产 {aid!r} 不存在", details={"asset_id": aid})
52	        unique.add(aid)
53	    return sorted(unique)
54	
55	
56	def _match_chains(
57	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list],
58	    start: _State,
59	    query: _State,
60	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
61	    """从 ``start`` 正向 BFS，返回到达全部命中状态的最短链（按目标排序）。
62	
63	    命中状态：位于所查 ``(schema, version)`` 且路径与所查路径相等或
64	    祖先/后代包含。每个状态的父指针在首次发现时确定；邻接状态按定位
65	    元组升序扩展，因此等长链中保留的是步进定位元组稳定最小者。
66	    """
67	    parent: dict[_State, _State | None] = {start: None}
68	    queue: list[tuple[_State, int]] = [(start, 0)]
69	    matched: list[_State] = []
70	    edges_walked = 0
71	    head = 0
72	    while head < len(queue):
73	        state, depth = queue[head]
74	        head += 1
75	        if depth >= limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH:
76	            raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
77	                "影响链深度超过公开限制",
78	                details={
79	                    "reason": "depth_exceeded",
80	                    "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH,
81	                    "schema": state[0],
82	                    "version": state[1],
83	                    "path": state[2],
84	                },
85	            )
86	        sp_path = ptr.parse(state[2])
87	        mapped_states: set[_State] = set()
88	        for edge in outgoing.get((state[0], state[1]), ()):
89	            ep = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
90	            if not (len(ep) <= len(sp_path) and sp_path[: len(ep)] == ep):
91	                continue
92	            edges_walked += 1
93	            if edges_walked > limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED:
94	                raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
95	                    "影响链引用边数量超过公开限制",
96	                    details={
97	                        "reason": "edges_exceeded",
98	                        "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED,
99	                    },
100	                )
101	            suffix = sp_path[len(ep) :]
102	            mapped_states.add(
103	                (
104	                    edge.dst_schema,
105	                    edge.dst_version,
106	                    ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix)),
107	                )
108	            )
109	        for nxt in sorted(mapped_states):
110	            if nxt in parent:
111	                continue
112	            parent[nxt] = state
113	            queue.append((nxt, depth + 1))
114	            if (
115	                nxt[0] == query[0]
116	                and nxt[1] == query[1]
117	                and _related(nxt[2], query[2])
118	            ):
119	                matched.append(nxt)
120	
121	    chains: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
122	    for target in sorted(matched):
123	        states: list[_State] = []
124	        cur: _State | None = target
125	        while cur is not None:
126	            states.append(cur)
127	            cur = parent[cur]
128	        states.reverse()
129	        chains.append(
130	            {
131	                "source": _locator(states[0]),
132	                "steps": [
133	                    {"from": _locator(states[i]), "to": _locator(states[i + 1])}
134	                    for i in range(len(states) - 1)
135	                ],
136	                "target": _locator(states[-1]),
137	            }
138	        )
139	    return chains
140	
141	
142	def explain_field(
143	    registry: Registry,
144	    schema: str,
145	    version: str,
146	    path: str,
147	    asset_ids: list[str] | None,
148	) -> dict[str, Any]:
149	    """按资产解释所查字段的影响链路（只读，不改动任何注册内容）。"""
150	    registry.get_schema(schema, version)  # 未知 Schema/版本抛 NotFoundError
151	    if not isinstance(path, str) or (path and not path.startswith("/")):
152	        raise NotFoundError(
153	            f"字段 {schema}@{version}{path!r} 不可达",
154	            details={"schema": schema, "version": version, "path": path},
155	        )
156	    if not registry.logical_path_exists(schema, version, path):
157	        raise NotFoundError(
158	            f"字段 {schema}@{version}{path} 不可达",
159	            details={"schema": schema, "version": version, "path": path},
160	        )
161	    selected = _resolve_asset_ids(registry, asset_ids)
162	
163	    query: _State = (schema, version, path)
164	    outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
165	    assets = {a.id: a for a in registry.all_assets()}
166	
167	    entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
168	    for aid in selected:
169	        asset = assets[aid]
170	        chains: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
171	        seen: set[tuple[_State, _State]] = set()
172	        has_direct = False
173	        has_transitive = False
174	        for ref in asset.refs:
175	            if (ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path) == query:
176	                # 直接命中：零步链，source 与 target 都是所查字段。
177	                has_direct = True
178	                key = (query, query)
179	                if key not in seen:
180	                    seen.add(key)
181	                    chains.append(
182	                        {
183	                            "source": _locator(query),
184	                            "steps": [],
185	                            "target": _locator(query),
186	                        }
187	                    )
188	                continue
189	            for chain in _match_chains(
190	                outgoing, (ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path), query
191	            ):
192	                has_transitive = True
193	                s, t = chain["source"], chain["target"]
194	                key = (
195	                    (s["schema"], s["version"], s["path"]),
196	                    (t["schema"], t["version"], t["path"]),
197	                )
198	                if key in seen:
199	                    continue
200	                seen.add(key)
201	                chains.append(chain)
202	        if not chains:
203	            continue
204	        if len(entries) + 1 > limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS:
205	            raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
206	                "影响资产数量超过公开限制",
207	                details={
208	                    "reason": "assets_exceeded",
209	                    "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS,
210	                },
211	            )
212	        chains.sort(
213	            key=lambda c: (
214	                c["source"]["schema"],
215	                c["source"]["version"],
216	                c["source"]["path"],
217	                c["target"]["schema"],
218	                c["target"]["version"],
219	                c["target"]["path"],
220	            )
221	        )
222	        impact_kind = (
223	            "both" if has_direct and has_transitive
224	            else "direct" if has_direct
225	            else "transitive"
226	        )
227	        entries.append(
228	            {
229	                "asset_id": asset.id,
230	                "name": asset.name,
231	                "kind": asset.kind,
232	                "impact_kind": impact_kind,
233	                "chains": chains,
234	            }
235	        )
236	
237	    return {
238	        "schema": schema,
239	        "version": version,
240	        "path": path,
241	        "assets": entries,
242	    }

63	    dst_schema: str
64	    dst_version: str
65	    dst_path: str
66	
67	
68	def parse_external_ref(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
69	    """解析跨 Schema 引用；非此外部形式返回 ``None``。"""
70	    m = _REF_RE.match(ref)
71	    if not m:
72	        return None
73	    return m.group("name"), m.group("version"), m.group("pointer")
74	
75	
76	def extract_ref_edges(name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> list[RefEdge]:
77	    """提取文档内全部跨 Schema 引用边（原始文档指针，按出现顺序排序）。
78	
79	    指针在注册时再结合两端文档解析为逻辑字段路径。
80	    """
81	    edges: list[RefEdge] = []
82	
83	    def walk(node: Any, path: str, seen: frozenset[int]) -> None:
84	        if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
85	            return
86	        if id(node) in seen:
87	            return
88	        seen = seen | {id(node)}
89	        if isinstance(node, dict):
90	            ref = node.get("$ref")
91	            if isinstance(ref, str):
92	                parsed = parse_external_ref(ref)
93	                if parsed is not None:
94	                    dst_name, dst_version, fragment = parsed
95	                    if fragment and not fragment.startswith("/"):
96	                        fragment = "/" + fragment
97	                    edges.append(
98	                        RefEdge(name, version, path, dst_name, dst_version, fragment)
99	                    )
100	            for k in sorted(node.keys()):
101	                walk(node[k], path + "/" + _escape(k) if path else "/" + _escape(k), seen)
102	        else:
103	            for i, v in enumerate(node):
104	                walk(v, f"{path}/{i}" if path else f"/{i}", seen)
105	
106	    walk(document, "", frozenset())
107	    edges.sort(key=lambda e: (e.src_path, e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.dst_path))
108	    return edges
109	
110	
111	def _escape(token: str) -> str:
112	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
113	
114	
115	class Registry:
116	    def __init__(self) -> None:
117	        self._schemas: dict[tuple[str, str], SchemaVersion] = {}
118	        # name -> 按注册顺序保存的版本列表
119	        self._versions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
120	        self._assets: dict[str, Asset] = {}
121	        self._edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[RefEdge, ...]] = {}
122	
123	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ schema
124	    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> SchemaVersion:
125	        validate_name(name, what="Schema 名称")
126	        validate_name(version, what="版本号")
127	        key = (name, version)
128	        if key in self._schemas:
129	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
130	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 已注册，注册内容不可覆盖",
131	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
132	            )
133	        # 跨 Schema 引用允许前向（目标稍后注册），因此引用环也可注册；
134	        # 目标缺失或目标字段不存在时，影响传播自然不会产生命中。
135	        raw_edges = extract_ref_edges(name, version, document)
136	        edges: list[RefEdge] = []
137	        for e in raw_edges:
138	            dst_record = self._schemas.get((e.dst_schema, e.dst_version))
139	            dst_raw = e.dst_path if e.dst_path else ""
140	            if dst_record is not None:
141	                dst_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(dst_record.document, dst_raw)
142	                if dst_logical is None or dst_logical not in _expand_fields(dst_record.document):
143	                    # 目标已注册但字段不存在：属于确定的非法引用。
144	                    raise NotFoundError(
145	                        f"跨 Schema 引用 {e.dst_schema}@{e.dst_version}{dst_raw} 的目标字段不存在",
146	                        details={
147	                            "schema": e.dst_schema,
148	                            "version": e.dst_version,
149	                            "path": dst_raw,
150	                        },
151	                    )
152	                final_dst = dst_logical
153	            else:
154	                final_dst = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(dst_raw)
155	            src_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, e.src_path)
156	            edges.append(
157	                RefEdge(
158	                    name,
159	                    version,
160	                    src_logical or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(e.src_path),
161	                    e.dst_schema,
162	                    e.dst_version,
163	                    final_dst,
164	                )
165	            )
166	        edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x.src_path, x.dst_schema, x.dst_version, x.dst_path))
167	        title = None
168	        if isinstance(document, dict):
169	            t = document.get("title")
170	            title = t if isinstance(t, str) else None
171	        record = SchemaVersion(name, version, copy.deepcopy(document), title)
172	        self._schemas[key] = record
173	        self._versions.setdefault(name, []).append(version)
174	        self._edges[key] = tuple(edges)
175	        return record
176	
177	    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> SchemaVersion:
178	        key = (name, version)
179	        if key not in self._schemas:
180	            raise NotFoundError(
181	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
182	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
183	            )
184	        return self._schemas[key]
185	
186	    def has_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> bool:
187	        return (name, version) in self._schemas
188	
189	    def schema_document(self, name: str, version: str) -> Any:
190	        return copy.deepcopy(self.get_schema(name, version).document)
191	
192	    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
193	        if name not in self._versions:
194	            raise NotFoundError(f"Schema {name} 不存在", details={"schema": name})
195	        return list(self._versions[name])
196	
197	    def edges(self, name: str, version: str) -> tuple[RefEdge, ...]:
198	        return self._edges.get((name, version), ())
199	
200	    def all_edges(self) -> list[RefEdge]:
201	        out: list[RefEdge] = []
202	        for key in sorted(self._edges):
203	            out.extend(self._edges[key])
204	        return out
205	
206	    def all_schemas(self) -> list[SchemaVersion]:
207	        return [self._schemas[k] for k in sorted(self._schemas)]
208	
209	    def registered_pairs(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
210	        """按全局注册顺序返回全部 ``(名称, 版本)``。"""
211	        return list(self._schemas.keys())
212	
213	    def logical_path_exists(self, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
214	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达（含沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 跳转解析）。"""
215	        return self._logical_path_exists(
216	            schema, version, path, frozenset({(schema, version)})
217	        )
218	
219	    def _logical_path_exists(
220	        self, schema: str, version: str, path: str, stack: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]
221	    ) -> bool:
222	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析。"""
223	        if (schema, version) not in self._schemas:
224	            return False
225	        document = self._schemas[(schema, version)].document
226	        valid_paths = _expand_fields(document)
227	        if path in valid_paths:
228	            return True
229	
230	        target_segs = ptr.parse(path)
231	        # 选择最长的、能覆盖目标路径前缀的出边。
232	        best = None
233	        for edge in self._edges.get((schema, version), ()):  # type: RefEdge
234	            esegs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
235	            if len(esegs) <= len(target_segs) and target_segs[: len(esegs)] == esegs:
236	                if best is None or len(esegs) > len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)):
237	                    best = edge
238	        if best is None:
239	            return False
240	        dst_key = (best.dst_schema, best.dst_version)
241	        if dst_key in stack:
242	            return False
243	        suffix = target_segs[len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)) :]
244	        resolved = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(best.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
245	        return self._logical_path_exists(
246	            best.dst_schema, best.dst_version, resolved, stack | {dst_key}
247	        )
248	
249	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- asset
250	    def register_asset(
251	        self,
252	        asset_id: str,
253	        name: str,
254	        kind: str,
255	        refs: list[FieldRef] | list[dict] | None = None,
256	    ) -> Asset:
257	        validate_name(asset_id, what="资产标识")
258	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
259	            raise ValueError("资产名称必须是非空字符串")
260	        if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind:
261	            raise ValueError("资产类型必须是非空字符串")
262	        if asset_id in self._assets:
263	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
264	                f"资产 {asset_id} 已注册", details={"asset": asset_id}
265	            )
266	
267	        normalized: list[FieldRef] = []
268	        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
269	        for raw in refs or []:
270	            if isinstance(raw, FieldRef):
271	                r = raw
272	            else:
273	                r = FieldRef(raw["schema"], str(raw["version"]), raw.get("path", ""))
274	            validate_name(r.schema, what="引用 Schema 名称")
275	            record = self.get_schema(r.schema, r.version)
276	            if r.path and not r.path.startswith("/"):
277	                raise ValueError(f"资产引用字段路径必须是 JSON Pointer: {r.path!r}")
278	            candidate_paths = []
279	            contextual = ptr.resolve_logical(record.document, r.path)
280	            if contextual is not None:
281	                candidate_paths.append(contextual)
282	            text_normalized = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(r.path)
283	            for cand in (text_normalized, r.path):
284	                if cand not in candidate_paths:
285	                    candidate_paths.append(cand)
286	
287	            resolved_path = next(
288	                (
289	                    cand
290	                    for cand in candidate_paths
291	                    if self._logical_path_exists(
292	                        r.schema, r.version, cand, frozenset({(r.schema, r.version)})
293	                    )
294	                ),
295	                None,
296	            )
297	            if resolved_path is None:
298	                raise NotFoundError(
299	                    f"资产引用的字段 {r.schema}@{r.version}{text_normalized} 不存在",
300	                    details={
301	                        "schema": r.schema,
302	                        "version": r.version,
303	                        "path": text_normalized,
304	                    },
305	                )
306	            r = FieldRef(r.schema, r.version, resolved_path)
307	            dedup_key = (r.schema, r.version, r.path)
308	            if dedup_key in seen:
309	                continue
310	            seen.add(dedup_key)
311	            normalized.append(r)
312	
313	        normalized.sort(key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
314	        asset = Asset(asset_id, name, kind, tuple(normalized))
315	        self._assets[asset_id] = asset
316	        return asset
317	
318	    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> Asset:
319	        if asset_id not in self._assets:
320	            raise NotFoundError(f"资产 {asset_id} 不存在", details={"asset": asset_id})
321	        return self._assets[asset_id]
322	
323	    def all_assets(self) -> list[Asset]:
324	        return [self._assets[k] for k in sorted(self._assets)]

"""升级影响汇总。

在字段级变更报告之上，按资产汇总一次 Schema 升级的影响：复用
:func:`meta_catalog.compare.build_report` 的全部比较语义（候选解析、字段对齐、
重命名、稳定排序与报告标识），不产生新的去重口径。

每个资产对每条命中变更保留至多一条记录，命中方式 ``impact_kind``：

  * ``direct``     资产直接引用了变更字段（出现在变更的直接影响资产中）；
  * ``transitive`` 资产经其他 Schema 传递引用了变更字段；
  * ``both``       同一变更上直接与传递同时命中。

资产状态 ``status`` 按命中变更的最严重兼容结论取值，严重顺序为
``breaking`` > ``compatible`` > ``metadata``；没有任何命中时为 ``unaffected``。
汇总只读注册簿，不构造报告、不入检索索引、不改动任何注册内容。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from . import compare as compare_mod
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import Registry

# status 严重顺序：下标越小越严重。
_SEVERITY = ("breaking", "compatible", "metadata")
_SEVERITY_RANK = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(_SEVERITY)}


def _resolve_asset_ids(
    registry: Registry, asset_ids: list[str] | None
) -> list[str]:
    """校验并去重资产选择，返回按 asset_id 升序的入选清单。

    ``None`` 表示覆盖全部资产；未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
    """
    if asset_ids is None:
        return [a.id for a in registry.all_assets()]
    unique: set[str] = set()
    for aid in asset_ids:
        if not isinstance(aid, str) or not aid:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"资产 {aid!r} 不存在", details={"asset": aid}
            )
        if aid in unique:
            continue
        registry.get_asset(aid)  # 未知资产抛 NotFoundError
        unique.add(aid)
    return sorted(unique)


def build_upgrade_report(
    registry: Registry,
    name: str,
    baseline_version: str,
    candidate_document: Any,
    candidate_version: str | None,
    renames: list | None,
    asset_ids: list[str] | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """构造升级影响汇总（不触碰注册内容、报告库与检索索引）。"""
    # 比较语义与 compare_schemas 完全一致：内部做字段数/变更数/影响链限制校验。
    report = compare_mod.build_report(
        registry,
        name,
        baseline_version,
        candidate_document,
        candidate_version,
        renames,
    )

    # 比较输入校验通过后再校验资产选择（未知资产抛 NotFoundError）。
    selected = _resolve_asset_ids(registry, asset_ids)

    assets = {a.id: a for a in registry.all_assets()}

    # 每个入选资产收集 (变更索引, impact_kind)；同一变更只保留一条。
    hits: dict[str, dict[int, str]] = {aid: {} for aid in selected}
    hit_paths: set[str] = set()
    for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
        direct_ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in change["direct_assets"]}
        transitive_ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in change["transitive_assets"]}
        for aid in selected:
            is_direct = aid in direct_ids
            is_transitive = aid in transitive_ids
            if not is_direct and not is_transitive:
                continue
            impact_kind = (
                "both" if is_direct and is_transitive
                else "direct" if is_direct
                else "transitive"
            )
            hits[aid][i] = impact_kind
            hit_paths.add(change["path"])

    asset_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    counts = {s: 0 for s in _SEVERITY}
    for aid in selected:
        asset = assets[aid]
        per_change = hits[aid]
        if not per_change:
            asset_entries.append(
                {
                    "asset_id": aid,
                    "name": asset.name,
                    "kind": asset.kind,
                    "status": "unaffected",
                    "changes": [],
                }
            )
            continue

        status = ""
        rank = len(_SEVERITY)
        changes_out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        # 变更沿用报告的稳定排序：按报告中的索引升序遍历。
        for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
            impact_kind = per_change.get(i)
            if impact_kind is None:
                continue
            entry = {k: change[k] for k in change}
            entry["impact_kind"] = impact_kind
            changes_out.append(entry)
            comp = change["compatibility"]
            comp_rank = _SEVERITY_RANK.get(comp, len(_SEVERITY))
            if comp_rank < rank:
                rank = comp_rank
                status = comp

        counts[status] += 1
        asset_entries.append(
            {
                "asset_id": aid,
                "name": asset.name,
                "kind": asset.kind,
                "status": status,
                "changes": changes_out,
            }
        )

    unaffected = len(selected) - sum(counts.values())
    return {
        "report_id": report["report_id"],
        "schema": report["schema"],
        "baseline_version": report["baseline_version"],
        "candidate_version": report["candidate_version"],
        "summary": {
            "asset_total": len(selected),
            "breaking_assets": counts["breaking"],
            "compatible_assets": counts["compatible"],
            "metadata_assets": counts["metadata"],
            "unaffected_assets": unaffected,
            "changed_paths": len(hit_paths),
        },
        "assets": asset_entries,
    }

1	"""字段路径工具。
2	
3	字段路径采用 JSON Pointer（RFC 6901）表示，例如 ``/properties/name``、
4	``/properties/a~1b``。根对象本身用空串 ``""`` 表示。
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Any
10	
11	
12	def escape(token: str) -> str:
13	    """转义单个路径段。"""
14	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
15	
16	
17	def unescape(token: str) -> str:
18	    """反转义单个路径段。"""
19	    return token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
20	
21	
22	def parse(path: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
23	    """把 JSON Pointer 解析为路径段元组；根路径返回空元组。"""
24	    if path == "":
25	        return ()
26	    if not path.startswith("/"):
27	        raise ValueError(f"非法 JSON Pointer: {path!r}")
28	    return tuple(unescape(seg) for seg in path[1:].split("/"))
29	
30	
31	def format(segments: tuple[str, ...] | list[str]) -> str:
32	    """把路径段组装为 JSON Pointer。"""
33	    return "".join("/" + escape(str(seg)) for seg in segments)
34	
35	
36	def child(path: str, segment: str) -> str:
37	    """返回某路径下的子路径。"""
38	    return (path + "/" + escape(segment)) if path else "/" + escape(segment)
39	
40	
41	def parent(path: str) -> str | None:
42	    """返回父路径；根路径返回 ``None``。"""
43	    segs = parse(path)
44	    if not segs:
45	        return None
46	    return format(segs[:-1])
47	
48	
49	def is_under(prefix: str, path: str) -> bool:
50	    """``path`` 是否位于 ``prefix`` 子树内（含自身）。"""
51	    p, c = parse(prefix), parse(path)
52	    return len(c) >= len(p) and c[: len(p)] == p
53	
54	
55	def resolve(doc: Any, path: str) -> Any:
56	    """在文档中按 JSON Pointer 取值，缺段/越界/类型不符时抛 KeyError。"""
57	    cur: Any = doc
58	    for seg in parse(path):
59	        if isinstance(cur, dict):
60	            if seg not in cur:
61	                raise KeyError(path)
62	            cur = cur[seg]
63	        elif isinstance(cur, list):
64	            try:
65	                idx = int(seg)
66	            except ValueError as exc:
67	                raise KeyError(path) from exc
68	            if not 0 <= idx < len(cur):
69	                raise KeyError(path)
70	            cur = cur[idx]
71	        else:
72	            raise KeyError(path)
73	    return cur
74	
75	
76	def normalize_field_pointer(path: str) -> str:
77	    """把 Schema 文档指针 *无上下文地* 规整为逻辑字段路径。
78	
79	    注意：纯文本规整无法区分「名为 ``items`` 的属性」与 ``items`` 关键字，
80	    资产/引用路径应优先使用逻辑路径，或用 :func:`resolve_logical` 结合
81	    文档解析。
82	    """
83	    segs = list(parse(path))
84	    out: list[str] = []
85	    for i, seg in enumerate(segs):
86	        if seg in ("properties", "prefixItems"):
87	            continue
88	        if seg == "additionalProperties":
89	            out.append("*")
90	        elif seg == "items":
91	            # 元组形式 items/0 展开为数组下标；单 Schema items 展开为 -。
92	            if i + 1 < len(segs) and segs[i + 1].isdigit():
93	                continue
94	            out.append("-")
95	        else:
96	            out.append(seg)
97	    return format(out)
98	
99	
100	def resolve_logical(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str | None:
101	    """结合文档结构，把文档指针解析为逻辑字段路径；不可解析返回 ``None``。
102	
103	    遍历规则与字段展开一致：``properties`` 段省略（其后必为属性名，即使
104	    名字恰好叫 ``items``）；单 Schema ``items`` 段映射为 ``-``；
105	    ``additionalProperties`` 映射为 ``*``；``$defs``/``definitions`` 保留。
106	    """
107	    segs = parse(raw_path)
108	    node: Any = document
109	    logical: list[str] = []
110	    i = 0
111	    while i < len(segs):
112	        seg = segs[i]
113	        if isinstance(node, dict):
114	            props = node.get("properties")
115	            if seg == "properties" and isinstance(props, dict):
116	                # 容器关键字与其后的属性名在同一步消费，避免属性名与
117	                # Schema 关键字（如名为 items 的属性）混淆。
118	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
119	                    return None
120	                name = segs[i + 1]
121	                if name not in props:
122	                    return None
123	                node = props[name]
124	                logical.append(name)
125	                i += 2
126	                continue
127	            pats = node.get("patternProperties")
128	            if seg == "patternProperties" and isinstance(pats, dict):
129	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
130	                    return None
131	                name = segs[i + 1]
132	                if name not in pats:
133	                    return None
134	                node = pats[name]
135	                logical.append(escape(name))
136	                i += 2
137	                continue
138	            ap = node.get("additionalProperties")
139	            if seg == "additionalProperties" and isinstance(ap, (dict, bool)):
140	                node = ap
141	                logical.append("*")
142	                i += 1
143	                continue
144	            items = node.get("items")
145	            if seg == "items" and isinstance(items, (dict, bool)):
146	                node = items
147	                logical.append("-")
148	                i += 1
149	                continue
150	            pre = node.get("prefixItems")
151	            if seg == "prefixItems" and isinstance(pre, list):
152	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
153	                    return None
154	                try:
155	                    idx = int(segs[i + 1])
156	                except ValueError:
157	                    return None
158	                if not 0 <= idx < len(pre):
159	                    return None
160	                node = pre[idx]
161	                logical.append(str(idx))
162	                i += 2
163	                continue
164	            if seg in ("$defs", "definitions") and isinstance(node.get(seg), dict):
165	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
166	                    return None
167	                name = segs[i + 1]
168	                if name not in node[seg]:
169	                    return None
170	                node = node[seg][name]
171	                logical.extend((seg, name))
172	                i += 2
173	                continue
174	            if seg not in node:
175	                return None
176	            node = node[seg]
177	            logical.append(seg)
178	            i += 1
179	        elif isinstance(node, list):
180	            try:
181	                idx = int(seg)
182	            except ValueError:
183	                return None
184	            if not 0 <= idx < len(node):
185	                return None
186	            node = node[idx]
187	            logical.append(seg)
188	            i += 1
189	        else:
190	            return None
191	    return format(logical)

import unittest

from meta_catalog import MetaCatalog
from meta_catalog.errors import NotFoundError


def schema(**props):
    return {"type": "object", "properties": props}


def loc(schema_name, version, path):
    return {"schema": schema_name, "version": version, "path": path}


class ExplainImpactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = MetaCatalog()
        self.c.register_schema(
            "Address", "1.0",
            schema(street={"type": "string"}, zip={"type": "string"}),
        )
        self.c.register_schema(
            "Person", "1.0",
            schema(name={"type": "string"}, address={"$ref": "Address@1.0#"}),
        )
        self.c.register_schema(
            "Company", "1.0",
            schema(contact={"$ref": "Person@1.0#/properties/address"}),
        )
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-mail", "邮寄服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Address", "version": "1.0", "path": "/street"}],
        )
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-billing", "账单服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/address/street"}],
        )
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-company", "公司服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Company", "version": "1.0", "path": "/contact/street"}],
        )

    def assets_by_id(self, result):
        return {a["asset_id"]: a for a in result["assets"]}

    def test_shape_and_direct_zero_step_chain(self):
        res = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        self.assertEqual(res["schema"], "Address")
        self.assertEqual(res["version"], "1.0")
        self.assertEqual(res["path"], "/street")
        mail = self.assets_by_id(res)["svc-mail"]
        self.assertEqual(mail["impact_kind"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(
            mail["chains"],
            [{
                "source": loc("Address", "1.0", "/street"),
                "steps": [],
                "target": loc("Address", "1.0", "/street"),
            }],
        )

    def test_transitive_chain_single_hop(self):
        res = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        billing = self.assets_by_id(res)["svc-billing"]
        self.assertEqual(billing["impact_kind"], "transitive")
        self.assertEqual(
            billing["chains"],
            [{
                "source": loc("Person", "1.0", "/address/street"),
                "steps": [{
                    "from": loc("Person", "1.0", "/address/street"),
                    "to": loc("Address", "1.0", "/street"),
                }],
                "target": loc("Address", "1.0", "/street"),
            }],
        )

    def test_transitive_chain_multi_hop(self):
        res = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        company = self.assets_by_id(res)["svc-company"]
        self.assertEqual(company["impact_kind"], "transitive")
        self.assertEqual(len(company["chains"]), 1)
        chain = company["chains"][0]
        self.assertEqual(chain["source"], loc("Company", "1.0", "/contact/street"))
        self.assertEqual(chain["target"], loc("Address", "1.0", "/street"))
        self.assertEqual(
            chain["steps"],
            [
                {
                    "from": loc("Company", "1.0", "/contact/street"),
                    "to": loc("Person", "1.0", "/address/street"),
                },
                {
                    "from": loc("Person", "1.0", "/address/street"),
                    "to": loc("Address", "1.0", "/street"),
                },
            ],
        )

    def test_assets_sorted_by_asset_id(self):
        res = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        ids = [a["asset_id"] for a in res["assets"]]
        self.assertEqual(ids, sorted(ids))

            "svc-both", "双重服务", "service",

        )

        )

            "Address", "1.0", "/street", asset_ids=["svc-billing", "svc-mail"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(res, res2)

        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.details.get("schema"), "Nope")

        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.details.get("path"), "/nope")
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.details.get("schema"), "Address")

            "svc-zip", "邮编服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Address", "version": "1.0", "path": "/zip"}],

        res = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        self.assertNotIn("svc-zip", self.assets_by_id(res))

    def test_ancestor_and_descendant_hits(self):
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-whole", "整对象服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/address"}],
        )

        res = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "")
        ids = self.assets_by_id(res)
        self.assertIn("svc-whole", ids)
        self.assertIn("svc-billing", ids)
        # 查询 /street：资产引用到达祖先路径 "" 也算命中。
        res2 = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        whole = self.assets_by_id(res2)["svc-whole"]
        self.assertEqual(whole["chains"][0]["target"], loc("Address", "1.0", ""))

    def test_shortest_chain_kept(self):
        c = MetaCatalog()
        c.register_schema("G", "1.0", schema(h={"type": "string"}))
        c.register_schema("E", "1.0", schema(b={"$ref": "G@1.0#"}))
        # D 根级引用 E，同时 /b 直接引用 G：同一 (source, target) 有两条链。
        c.register_schema("D", "1.0", {
            "$ref": "E@1.0#",
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {"b": {"$ref": "G@1.0#"}},
        })
        c.register_asset(
            "svc-d", "D服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "D", "version": "1.0", "path": "/b/h"}],
        )
        res = c.explain_impact("G", "1.0", "/h")
        chains = self.assets_by_id(res)["svc-d"]["chains"]
        self.assertEqual(len(chains), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            chains[0]["steps"],
            [{"from": loc("D", "1.0", "/b/h"), "to": loc("G", "1.0", "/h")}],
        )

    def test_cycle_terminates_without_duplicate_chains(self):
        c = MetaCatalog()
        c.register_schema("A", "1.0", schema(
            x={"type": "string"}, b={"$ref": "B@1.0#"},
        ))
        c.register_schema("B", "1.0", schema(
            y={"type": "string"}, a={"$ref": "A@1.0#"},
        ))
        c.register_asset(
            "svc-a", "A服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "A", "version": "1.0", "path": "/x"}],
        )
        res = c.explain_impact("A", "1.0", "/x")
        entry = self.assets_by_id(res)["svc-a"]
        self.assertEqual(entry["impact_kind"], "direct")
        self.assertEqual(len(entry["chains"]), 1)

    def test_deterministic_and_independent_copy(self):
        r1 = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        r2 = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        self.assertEqual(r1, r2)
        r1["assets"][0]["chains"].append({"source": {}, "steps": [], "target": {}})
        r1["assets"].clear()
        r3 = self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        self.assertEqual(r2, r3)

    def test_read_only_side_effects(self):
        before_reports = self.c.list_reports()
        before_search = self.c.search("street")
        self.c.explain_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        self.assertEqual(self.c.list_reports(), before_reports)
        self.assertEqual(self.c.search("street"), before_search)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from meta_catalog import MetaCatalog
from meta_catalog.errors import NotFoundError


def schema(**props):
    return {"type": "object", "properties": props}


class ImpactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = MetaCatalog()
        self.c.register_schema(
            "Address",
            "1.0",
            schema(street={"type": "string"}, zip={"type": "string"}),
        )
        self.c.register_schema(
            "Person",
            "1.0",
            schema(
                name={"type": "string"},
                address={"$ref": "Address@1.0#"},
            ),
        )
        self.c.register_schema(
            "Company",
            "1.0",
            schema(contact={"$ref": "Person@1.0#/properties/address"}),
        )
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-mail", "邮寄服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Address", "version": "1.0", "path": "/street"}],
        )
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-billing", "账单服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/address/street"}],
        )
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-company", "公司服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Company", "version": "1.0", "path": "/contact/street"}],
        )

    def test_direct_assets(self):
        imp = self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        self.assertEqual([a["asset_id"] for a in imp["direct_assets"]], ["svc-mail"])

    def test_transitive_assets_multihop(self):
        imp = self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        trans = {(a["asset_id"], a["schema"], a["path"]) for a in imp["transitive_assets"]}
        self.assertIn(("svc-billing", "Person", "/address/street"), trans)
        self.assertIn(("svc-company", "Company", "/contact/street"), trans)

    def test_transitive_deduplicated_by_stable_path(self):
        # 同一资产经多条引用边到达同一稳定路径只出现一次。
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-dup", "重复服务", "service",
            [
                {"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/address/street"},
            ],
        )
        imp = self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        rows = [
            a for a in imp["transitive_assets"] if a["asset_id"] == "svc-dup"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 1)

    def test_transitive_order_is_stable(self):
        imp1 = self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        imp2 = self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "1.0", "/street")
        key = lambda rows: [(a["asset_id"], a["schema"], a["path"]) for a in rows]
        self.assertEqual(key(imp1["transitive_assets"]), key(imp2["transitive_assets"]))

    def test_root_change_propagates(self):
        # 整个 Address 根对象变更，引用 /address 或 /address/street 都受影响。
        self.c.register_asset(
            "svc-whole", "整对象服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/address"}],
        )
        imp = self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "1.0", "")
        ids = {a["asset_id"] for a in imp["transitive_assets"]}
        self.assertIn("svc-whole", ids)
        self.assertIn("svc-billing", ids)

    def test_unknown_version_raises_not_found(self):
        with self.assertRaises(NotFoundError):
            self.c.analyze_impact("Address", "9.9", "/street")

    def test_cross_schema_cycle_terminates(self):
        c = MetaCatalog()
        c.register_schema("A", "1.0", schema(
            x={"type": "string"},
            b={"$ref": "B@1.0#"},
        ))
        c.register_schema("B", "1.0", schema(
            y={"type": "string"},
            a={"$ref": "A@1.0#"},
        ))
        c.register_asset(
            "svc-a", "A服务", "service",
            [{"schema": "A", "version": "1.0", "path": "/x"}],
        )
        # 双向环 + 资产引用，必须终止且不把起点错记为传递资产。
        imp = c.analyze_impact("A", "1.0", "/x")
        ids = [a["asset_id"] for a in imp["transitive_assets"]]
        self.assertEqual(ids.count("svc-a"), 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
